coordinate_space: Relative to the Phase 1 rectified canonical card. rect is [x, y, w, h] with every component in [0, 1]; pixel bbox = [round(x*W), round(y*H), round((x+w)*W), round((y+h)*H)].
calibration_note: Phase 2A visually audited v2 on all 7 accepted Phase 1 rectified cards at 0, 90, 180, and 270 degrees. Geometry is unchanged from v2. The three proposed printed-birth-date boxes did not surround an independently printed birth-date field, so v3 disables their field semantics while retaining the boxes as non-readable audit landmarks. No OCR tuning, preprocessing, or PSM change was made.

observed_bands.note: Median normalized rects of the text bands seen across the 7 rectified cards, with the number of cards supporting each. Geometry only.

content_types.digits: Numeric only. OCR is whitelisted to ASCII digits; Arabic-Indic and Extended Arabic-Indic digits are folded to ASCII at read time and the fold is recorded as a note.
content_types.date_digits: Numeric plus the separators / - . and space, so the group structure that disambiguates field order survives.
content_types.arabic_text: Arabic script only: letters plus tatweel and tashkeel. OCR runs with lang=ara. Diacritics are kept in the value and removed only in the comparison form.
content_types.none: Not read. Drawn on the debug overlay so the layout can be checked, e.g. the portrait.

role_note: No current v3 layout declares an independently printed birth-date field. Date of birth is derived from national-ID digits and must be emitted with state derived. Exactly one id_number region is permitted per layout. externally_verified is reserved for a later comparison with independent application data.

front.description: Portrait on the left, name and address block on the right, national ID number across the lower band. Band positions fitted; field identities unconfirmed.

regions.name: header_line
regions.note: Present on 7/7 cards. Not read; drawn so the overlay shows the fit.

regions.name: national_id_number
regions.note: Fitted to the wide lower band present on 6/7 cards.

regions.name: unassigned_lower_left_band
regions.note: v2 proposed this as a printed birth date. Phase 2A found that it surrounds a serial band on the audited front cards, so it is not read.

regions.name: unassigned_front_right_band
regions.note: v2 proposed this as a printed birth date. Phase 2A found that it overlaps the name block, so it is not read.

back.description: Detail block on the right, serial across the lower half. No rectified back was available to fit against, so every rect here is still a prior.

regions.name: unassigned_back_middle_right
regions.note: v2 proposed this as a printed birth date. Phase 2A found no independently printed birth-date field in this box, so it is not read.
